response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software engineering with a strong background in AI and cloud technologies, particularly in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling. While his entrepreneurial experience is notable, his AI strategy and product development focus could be better aligned with the Director-level role. His diverse tech stack and open-source contributions demonstrate innovation and leadership potential.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on AI and cloud technologies
Proven expertise in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (e.g., MCP code generators, AI frameworks)
Entrepreneurial experience with GISCollective, an open-source geo-data platform
concerns: Limited explicit mention of AI product strategy or high-level AI platform design experience
Current role at re:cinq focuses on AI-agent infrastructure rather than strategic AI product leadership
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in AI or related field
